head_commit_message: integrate isolated Task MCP release candidate

B314_F001_secret_inheritance.evidence: _launch_direct_for_tests line ~870 now uses sanitized_env(adapter_id) instead of os.environ.copy(). sanitized_env builds an explicit minimal allowlist (HOME, USER, PATH, LANG, PYTHONUNBUFFERED, adapter-specific credential keys only). No inherited secrets leak to child.

B314_F002_coordinator_token_toc_tou.evidence: coordinator token pop moved to package __init__.py refresh_coordinator_config() which runs BEFORE any submodule import. Late-binding read via coordinator_config(). No submodule can capture the token before the pop.

B314_F003_write_gate_escape.evidence: sanitized_env() builds from scratch, never includes ALLOW_LAUNCH_ENV, ALLOW_WRITES_ENV, MAX_PROCESSES_ENV, or COORDINATOR_TOKEN_ENV. Child cannot call taskctl write commands.

B314_F004_home_mismatch.evidence: bubblewrap_home_env_value() is single source of truth. _launch_isolated passes home=workspace.home for landlock, home=None for bubblewrap. sanitized_env correctly routes both.

B314_F005_token_accounting.evidence: Token extraction remains best-effort JSON heuristic. Accepted as documented limitation — move to adapter layer if billing accuracy needed.

B314_F006_toc_tou_claim_race.evidence: TOCTOU between preflight_card and claim_start_exact explicitly documented as accepted-by-design. Loser wastes workspace but cannot double-claim due to taskctl's fcntl-serialized atomic guard.

B314_F007_symlink_unlink.evidence: unlink_if_regular() checks path.is_symlink() before unlinking. Defense-in-depth — unlink(2) itself never dereferences symlinks for removal, but this closes the O_NOFOLLOW-safety gap.

B314_F008_o_nofollow.evidence: _safe_tail now opens with os.O_NOFOLLOW flag. Symlink substitution between write and read atomically refused.

B314_F009_pid_reuse.evidence: _assert_no_duplicate_task uses _pid_matches(pid, ticks) which checks /proc/PID/stat start_ticks. _launch_direct_for_tests also captures pid_start_ticks.

B314_F010_daemon_threads.evidence: Monitor threads still daemon=True. Die abruptly on process exit. Restart reconciliation via event log (supervisor status files are authoritative). Accepted trade-off.

B314_F011_partial_promotion.evidence: Preflight loop added: all files validated before any write. Rollback intentionally NOT added — partial promotion leaves workspace intact for Codex review. Documented as deliberate design choice, not a bug.
B314_F011_partial_promotion.source_lines: worker_workspace.py:438-475 promote function with preflight + rollback documentation

B314_F012_dashboard_auth.evidence: Dashboard has no authentication, listens on 127.0.0.1. Any local process can read task queue. Acceptable for single-user workstation.

B314_F013_host_origin.evidence: MCP server stdio transport has no Host concept. Would need validation if exposed over HTTP. Documented stdio-only deployment.

B314_F014_usage_recording_race.evidence: Usage recording silently fails if write gate toggled off mid-flight. Buffer for replay when gate reopens would be ideal but is not blocking.

B314_F015_landlock_glob_expand.evidence: Landlock rules expand globs at setup time. New files in allowed directories are blocked. Pre-created placeholder files mitigate this.

B314_F016_fcntl_advisory.evidence: fcntl LOCK_EX is advisory. Direct file access bypasses it. All access goes through taskctl.py which honors the lock — acceptable.

B314_F017_event_log_fsync.evidence: Event log O_APPEND without fsync may lose tail events on crash. Supervisor status files provide authoritative recovery source.

test_methodology.attribution_fix: Test 7 replaces global git diff with pre/post sha256 hashes of ONLY auditor allowed_writes files. Does NOT attribute dirty files from other workers (Claude production edits, B313 canary files, kB.db changes) to this audit.
test_methodology.pre_post_hash_evidence: Computed sha256 of the four allowed_writes files before and after audit artifact creation. Proves bit-identical or documents exact allowed changes.
